description: When two finite binary partial maps agree on their overlap, their graph union is the graph of a finite common extension.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.graph_union_common_extension.{u} {α : Type u}
  {p q : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.BinaryMap α} (h : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.Agree p q) :
  ∃ r,
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.Extends r p ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.Extends r q ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.graph r =
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.graph p ∪ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.FinitePartialMaps.graph q
